findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.comment: No bleach or biohazard kit was available during today’s inspection. Norovirus signage is posted above the hand washing sink, however no spill kit is available for cleanup. Obtain a biohazard spill kit, or simple bleach (no “non-splash” or scented) with an EPA registration number by 10/17/25.
findings.citation_text: 2-501.11 Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. [Pf]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the front door to the facility to have a self closer that does not allow for the complete closing of the door. The back door also is allowing strips of light enter along the left perimeter of the door. Ensure all gaps and repaired or closed by the next routine inspection to protect against the entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Facility does not have test strips for the ready-to-use lactic acid sanitizer currently in use. Purchase test strips appropriate for the sanitizer in use.
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
Signed reporting agreements could not be located for the employees present. A blank reporting agreement is available. CORRECTED- Staff signed reporting agreements. Others are kept in a Health Department binder. Ensure the policy is reviewed with all new employees.
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  [Pf]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed to turn the faucet off without the use of a barrier after washing hands. CORRECTED- Inspector provided education. Ensure employees use a barrier to turn the faucet off after washing hands to prevent recontamination of hands. Review when to wash with employees as well.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]
